title: Pocket Magic Bottle
text: Craft an empty bottle from spell ink and a primordial spell core. Right-click to capture an ordinary creature; right-click again to throw the filled bottle and release it on impact. Releasing a tamed creature drops an empty magic bottle, regardless of its owner; releasing other contents consumes the bottle. Sneak-right-click instead erases the contents permanently and leaves an empty bottle.

Hostile or angered neutral creatures, bosses, players and detached creature parts cannot be captured. Riding groups must be captured from their lowest member; every member must qualify, and leads must be removed first. Armor stands, displays, vehicles, dropped items and projectiles cannot be captured alone.

An empty bottle can also capture an entire Omnira multiblock work structure by right-clicking any part, preserving contents and progress. It stays bottled if the release site lacks room. A filled bottle can be carried or placed on a Crystal Pedestal, but cannot enter other containers.
With Aeronautics installed, a complete connected physical structure can also be bottled once players disembark. Creatures and structures can cross dimensions within the same world this way.
